purpose: Versioned extension of the single Stödassistenten demand/friction regression map. This mapping stores product-learning memory only; it does not prove eligibility, payment continuity, housing-support entitlement or factual truth.

mappings.product_miss: The product already knows activity compensation as a support for young adults but does not yet lock the high-consequence age-30 transition. Without a regression, it can imply an automatic move to sickness compensation, overlook sickness benefit in special cases when low/no SGI and protection facts matter, or treat bostadstillägg and boendetillägg as one continuous housing-support decision.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Keep all transition paths inside the same disability/person learning system. First establish that activity compensation is ending and the work-capacity prognosis; only ask SGI and protection facts when they can change the special-cases route. Never promise automatic conversion. Verify housing support after the primary benefit route is known, and keep bostadstillägg separate from boendetillägg. All material rules remain primary-source dependent and review-gated.
